saints.name: St. Andrew
saints.title: Apostle
saints.shortBlurb: The brother of Simon Peter, first-called of the Apostles, who brought others to Christ and died on the X-shaped cross…
biography: Andrew, a fisherman of Bethsaida and brother of Simon Peter, was first a disciple of John the Baptist and, hearing him point to the Lamb of God, followed Jesus and brought his brother to Him — whence he is called the First-Called. He appears in the Gospels bringing others to Christ, the boy with the loaves and the inquiring Greeks.
Tradition holds that he preached in Greece and was crucified at Patras on a cross in the form of an X. He is the patron of Scotland, Greece, and Russia.
saints.knownFor: The first-called Apostle who brought others to Christ.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 30 November
